blind.description: A wooden pedestal chess table with a square top, thick rim, central turned pedestal pillar, and four curved splayed wooden feet. An 8x8 checkerboard is inlaid or set into the tabletop, populated with stylised light-wood and dark-wood chess pieces standing on various squares across the board. The model has solid, continuous geometry with smooth stylized hand-painted wood textures, free from cracks, shards, floating fragments, or fused elements.
blind.from_above: A square wooden border enclosing a checkered square board with beige and dark brown tiles, scattered with cream and dark brown chess pieces, casting rectangular/square shadows on the floor alongside the column's shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (roughly up to mid-thigh or waist of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 2.2 feet wide across the square tabletop.
